question: Which topics are assigned to the thirtieth and thirty-first chapters in this overview?
premises: The nature of mantra and its power are explained in the thirtieth chapter.
The division of trident and lotus is treated in the thirty-first chapter.
The explanation of the sky, swastika, and related forms is treated in the thirty-first chapter.
inference: The thirtieth chapter concerns mantra and its power, while the thirty-first concerns the trident-lotus division and related diagrammatic explanations.
uncertainties: The exact ritual or diagrammatic referents of śūlābja and vyomaśasvastika are not specified in this verse.
plain_english: In the thirtieth chapter, the nature of mantra and its power are explained. In the thirty-first, the division of the trident and lotus and the explanation of the sky, the swastika, and so on are to be set forth in detail.
